sourceVerification: Supplied secondary report fully read. External citations/status/legal/deployment assertions unverified.

requirements.title: Separate asset, position and entitlement
requirements.requirement: Describe asset domain/identifier/version/unit, holder, obligor, underlying, rights and exit conditions separately; do not infer legal ownership from a token interface.

requirements.title: Conserve claims through transformations
requirements.requirement: Bind input/output claims, quantities, fees/rounding and retained or explicitly discharged obligations for admitted transfer, wrap/redeem, pledge/release, liquidation, split/merge, refinance, recovery and migration operations. Reuse Core/library operations where sufficient.

requirements.title: Separate encumbrance and restriction
requirements.requirement: Represent pledge, settlement hold, freeze and priority distinctly; partial liquidation/release preserves exact encumbered quantity and residual debt.

requirements.title: Check every operation policy
requirements.requirement: Check the applicable rule on transfer, receipt transfer, redemption, liquidation, issuance/burn, recovery and migration; scoped exceptions must be explicit. ABI/selector compatibility is insufficient.

requirements.title: Scope exceptional authority
requirements.requirement: Bind issuer/holder/operation/asset/quantity/recipient/time/policy version and reason. Recovery creates a new transition; it neither deletes history nor extends authority over another asset.

requirements.title: Bind identity and credential freshness
requirements.requirement: Distinguish key control, address eligibility, beneficial owner and credential claims. Specify issuer trust, schema, expiry/revocation, policy activation and replay domains; previews do not authorize execution.

requirements.title: Model servicing and persistent claims
requirements.requirement: Separate transfer controls from coupons, record dates, distributions, capitalization, default and redemption servicing. Pending or partial progress carries remaining claims and duties.

requirements.title: Close bounded composition paths
requirements.requirement: Bound positions, dependencies, credentials and nesting; test wrapper, custody, batch, liquidation, exit and migration paths, including conflicting policies and rejection without partial unintended effects.

requirements.title: Bind history and explicit trust
requirements.requirement: Bind asset/claim identities, authority, policy version and obligations into admitted history and ledger statements. State finality, custody, oracle and legal assumptions; no bridge or credential proves external truth merely by preserving quantity or signatures.

requirements.title: Minimize disclosure and explain authority
requirements.requirement: Specify visibility for identities, balances and credentials, including failure diagnostics; derive the signing display from canonical signed bytes and expose all authority-impacting fields, residual rights and exit constraints.

requirements.title: Require staged target evidence
requirements.requirement: Implement accepted profiles in source/Core/K/evaluator and backend; run Docker positive/rejection cases before separately admitted Midnight Preview tests. Retain finalized transaction IDs, full effects, residual obligations and cleanup evidence.

cases.title: Restricted wrapper
cases.positive: Eligible deposit, policy-compliant receipt transfer and available redemption preserve the intended claim.
cases.reject: Receipt transfer bypasses the declared entitlement restriction, or a deposit is misrepresented as an exit guarantee.
cases.equivalenceDisposition: new case; no prior case replaced or counted as equivalent

cases.title: Partial pledge and liquidation
cases.positive: Pledge6 of10 receipt units, liquidate2, retain4 pledged and4 unpledged; apply independently denominated proceeds and retain residual debt.
cases.reject: Release all6, seize a different asset, double-count collateral or erase remaining debt.
cases.equivalenceDisposition: new case; no prior case replaced or counted as equivalent

cases.title: Pending redemption
cases.positive: Request, partial fulfillment and residual claim/duty remain distinguishable from paid redemption.
cases.reject: Burn the request claim without preserving its duty, or substitute NAV for realized cash.
cases.equivalenceDisposition: new case; no prior case replaced or counted as equivalent

cases.title: Scoped exceptional recovery
cases.positive: A specific exceptional grant authorizes a new asset-scoped recovery transition and preserves encumbrances/history.
cases.reject: Holder grant becomes seizure power, assetA authority changes assetB, or prior history is removed.
cases.equivalenceDisposition: new case; no prior case replaced or counted as equivalent

cases.title: Record-date servicing
cases.positive: Bounded snapshot and event-order rules pay the entitled holder exactly once.
cases.reject: Pay both pre/post transfer holders or silently select the current token holder for an earlier record date.
cases.equivalenceDisposition: new case; no prior case replaced or counted as equivalent

cases.title: Stale policy and migration
cases.positive: Authorized migration binds old/new identity and policy, retires the old authoritative representation, and preserves work/history.
cases.reject: Accept expired or revoked evidence, a stale preview, duplicate successor, unrestricted old version or reset budget.
cases.equivalenceDisposition: new case; no prior case replaced or counted as equivalent

cases.title: Mixed-policy bounded settlement
cases.positive: Every leg satisfies its own normal/exceptional policy and the declared atomicity boundary.
cases.reject: One asset grant bypasses another policy or failure leaves an unintended single-leg transfer.
cases.equivalenceDisposition: new case; no prior case replaced or counted as equivalent

cases.title: Private eligibility
cases.positive: Scoped predicate and freshness proof reveals only the declared information under explicit issuer trust.
cases.reject: Replay across asset/policy domains, stale revocation evidence, or unnecessary identity disclosure through diagnostics.
cases.equivalenceDisposition: new case; no prior case replaced or counted as equivalent

integrationRules: All eleven requirements and eight cases are additional obligations under their existing sprint/MC gates.
An implementation can reuse an existing case only with a reviewed exact behavior/effect/negative-control equivalence map.
A requirement needing an unadmitted primitive remains explicitly open; do not weaken it to fit the atomic subset.
Financial convention, legal interpretation, source/IR constructor and resource changes still require their existing design/admission reviews.
Keep 277 ACTUS fixtures,32 taxonomy dispositions,18 executable types,72 DeFi rows,DA01-DA24,eight intents,three heldouts,eight regressions,five composition operators and all TX/VX cases.
Midnight is the backend; Cardano and ERC examples provide comparative requirements, not new adapters.
Do not infer primary verification, protocol conformance, legal compliance or current standard status from this report.
